0|b5861e5cf2fcf83031ea3e26b0a69d887adf7d21|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"KVM: nVMX: Fix loss of pending IRQ/NMI before entering L2
Consider the case L1 had a IRQ/NMI event until it executed
VMLAUNCH/VMRESUME which wasn't delivered because it was disallowed
(e.g. interrupts disabled). When L1 executes VMLAUNCH/VMRESUME
L0 needs to evaluate if this pending event should cause an exit from
L2 to L1 or delivered directly to L2 (e.g. In case L1 don't intercept
EXTERNAL_INTERRUPT).
Usually this would be handled by L0 requesting a IRQ/NMI window
by setting VMCS accordingly. However
VMCS01 and now VMCS02 is active instead. Thus
VMLAUNCH/VMRESUME we force L0 to perform pending event evaluation by
requesting a KVM_REQ_EVENT.
Note that above scenario exists when L1 KVM is about to enter L2 but
requests an ""immediate-exit"". As in this case
disable-interrupts and then send a self-IPI before entering L2.
